Messages.Author: Andy Brown
Messages.Body:
This has probably been asked before, but hasn't ever come up
in my playgroup (due to lack of Freak Drives) but may do with
the new CE.

Is a successful Political Action one in which a vote is called
(the action is successful), or one in which the Referendum is
also passed, in terms for playing Freak Drive.

Thanks for answer

Andy "Slytherin" Brown
VEKN Setite Ruler of Cambridge
SET awakens, watch out all non-believers

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andy Brown wrote:
>
> This has probably been asked before, but hasn't ever come up
> in my playgroup (due to lack of Freak Drives) but may do with
> the new CE.
>
> Is a successful Political Action one in which a vote is called
> (the action is successful), or one in which the Referendum is
> also passed, in terms for playing Freak Drive.

Freak Drive only ever cares about the action being unblocked.
If doesn't care if the referendum fails, or if the bleed is for
0 or less, or if the hunt results in no blood gain, etc.
